definitions.explanation: A cluster of people gathered around something of interest, such as a street performance, an accident scene, or a shop display.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}だかり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{人|ひと}だかり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A crowd is gathering in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{人|ひと}だかり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A large crowd had gathered at the intersection — I wonder what happened.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (people) and {集|たか}り (gathering), where たかり undergoes rendaku to become だかり. Describes a spontaneous gathering of onlookers rather than a planned assembly. The most common construction is {人|ひと}だかり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人|ひと}だかり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: a crowd forms
- {人|ひと}だかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: in the crowd
- ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧{人|ひと}だかり: an impressive crowd
- {人|ひと}だかり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to see a crowd

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人混|ひとご}み: crowd — a general crowd in a busy area, not necessarily gathered around something specific
- ⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧: crowd, mob — a larger, more formal word often used in news or literature
- ⟦{野次馬|やじうま}→野次馬：16403_yajiuma⟧: rubbernecker, onlooker — focuses on the people watching rather than the crowd itself
